name: hollywood_context
description: Read your identity and the real participants of an authorized room. Room membership is communication, not task ownership.

name: hollywood_read_room
description: Read canonical recent room conversation or explicitly requested execution activity.

name: hollywood_publish
description: Publish in your own agent identity. A public message is shared context; recipientId explicitly addresses a peer. Direct audience is private. Accepted means stored, not answered. Use responsePhase answer for a deliberate answer to the human, update for progress, blocked for a blocker, and message for other conversation. An answer makes a response available; it does not assert all work is complete. Do not publish routine acknowledgements.

name: hollywood_rooms
description: Discover only rooms this agent is authorized to read; observation never starts another agent context.

name: hollywood_room_info
description: Inspect authorized room ownership, actors and current membership revisions before changing grants. Administrators can see all grants; others see their own.

name: hollywood_agents
description: Administrator: list all agent identities in this authority, including agents without rooms. Follow nextAfter for complete pages. Enrollment active is not placement or execution status. Contains no credentials; reading grants no execution.

name: hollywood_agent_info
description: Inspect an authorized agent's current primary role, home room and revision before updating its role.

name: hollywood_create_agent
description: Administrator: create a stable scoped agent and primary responsibility. Credential stays protected in LAX. This does not provision execution.

name: hollywood_create_room
description: Administrator: create a Hollywood room with an accountable agent owner and clear purpose. The owner initially receives read/post/request membership; inspect hollywood_room_info for its current revision before changing grants.

name: hollywood_set_role
description: Administrator: revise a primary role with revision compare-and-swap; role names do not grant authority.

nativeGoalScope.description: Administrator selects ongoing role responsibility or separately addressed work. Does not grant room, host or resource permissions.

decisionOwnerId.description: Explicit active human for role-origin questions/approvals. Omit to preserve; null withdraws routing. Does not confer room, host or resource rights.

name: hollywood_grant_room
description: Administrator: explicitly grant room observation, posting or execution-request rights; none grant host access. First inspect hollywood_room_info for the current membership revision; revision 0 means absent membership.

name: lax_provision_room_agent
description: Provision an already enrolled and joined agent on this configured local host. Requires current communication administrator and verified local sudo; does not create a replacement identity, send instructions or claim task completion.

name: hollywood_admin_reconcile
description: Inspect and continue the exact original administrative workflow after an unknown result. Never creates a replacement operation or repeats an uncertain write. Requires current administrator authority.
